title: 2 Hour Semi-Private Surf Lesson
includes: wetsuit (only needed through mid to late april) (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: The 2 Hour Semi-private surf Lesson is perfect for the family or your group of friends.  Considering the laughter of all the wipe-outs and horrays of all the success you will have in the water, this is a sure way to create a memory that will last a lifetime.  Come surf with us and enjoy the day!
